cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — holds a towel folded against her chest; a glasshouse conservatory on a cold modern winter afternoon — she holds a large empty spiral shell to her ear and listens to its echo as though the distant southern coast were inside it; a small modern estuary ferry landing with timber benches — waiting for the local ferry; a far-future public orbital transit lounge — taking a quiet local shuttle trip instead of commanding a fleet; a private zero-gravity leisure alcove on a far-future orbital carrier — off duty; a modern seaside floating leisure dock on a clear tidal lagoon — she laughs softly as she tests the wobbly floating dock while sitting into the waiting swim ring; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a quiet cabin on a modern overnight river ferry — she sits on the edge of the bunk enjoying the first bite of a peeled mandarin while watching the coast drift past; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — holds a few lit incense sticks in both hands before her; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — standing; her living room with a deep sofa — plays an acoustic guitar; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds a masquerade mask on a stick up to her eyes; an art or pottery studio of easels — holds her keepsake at chest height
